product_risk_or_requirement: Legal privacy and medical-device classification are not approved
current_state: Only a preliminary uncertain classification and conceptual data flow exist
product_requirement: Block real-patient use until intended purpose roles sensitive-data processing and device status are approved
acceptance_criteria: Given the frozen intended purpose workflow data map vendors and markets When readiness is reviewed Then signed AI privacy and medical-device classification memos are present
deadline_or_trigger: Before processing any real patient data
evidence_needed: Signed legal memo privacy impact assessment intended-purpose statement and data-flow record

product_risk_or_requirement: Red-flag and under-triage performance are not independently validated
current_state: Published evidence shows relevant failure modes but only a draft local test set exists
product_requirement: Validate every supported symptom pathway on representative local scenarios with subgroup and edge-case analysis
acceptance_criteria: Given a frozen release candidate and clinician-approved scenario set When independent safety evaluation runs Then emergency recall is at least 99% unsafe triage is zero and subgroup results meet approved bounds
evidence_needed: Versioned protocol test set evaluation report subgroup tables and Medical Director approval

product_risk_or_requirement: Escalation downtime consent and incident workflows are not rehearsed
current_state: Roles are proposed but no completed drill or audit evidence exists
product_requirement: Provide staffed escalation manual fallback consent withdrawal incident response and rollback with time-bound ownership
acceptance_criteria: Given red-flag privacy downtime and hallucination simulations When the clinic executes the runbook Then every event meets response times preserves evidence and completes escalation rollback and patient communication
deadline_or_trigger: At least fourteen days before supervised pilot
evidence_needed: Drill report audit logs staffing roster consent test incident record and rollback proof

product_risk_or_requirement: Drift and harmful-advice monitoring need production ownership
current_state: Metrics are defined but monitoring alerts and retention are not implemented
product_requirement: Create weekly safety review and event-triggered pause with versioned model prompt protocol and evaluation evidence
acceptance_criteria: Given monitoring data and version metadata When a threshold is breached Then owners are alerted the system pauses and every affected intake is queued for manual review
evidence_needed: Dashboard alert test change log retention policy and safety review minutes

product_risk_or_requirement: Patients with low digital literacy may submit incomplete intake with no alternative channel
current_state: A phone or in-person intake alternative is proposed but not implemented or tested
product_requirement: Provide and test an accessible phone or in-person intake option with a mandatory nurse callback when self-report confidence is flagged low
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient flagged with low self-report confidence When intake is submitted Then a nurse calls back within fifteen minutes and the patient can complete intake by phone
evidence_needed: Accessible intake pilot test low-confidence flag report and nurse callback log
